question: Within receptor-positive reviewed receiver identities, is a fixed expression programme associated with the fraction of ligand-positive cells among nearby sender-family cells beyond family abundance, RNA quality and spatial context?

scope.unique_model_definition: sender_family,receiver_family,ligand,receptor,exact ordered programme genes; duplicate discovery contexts map once

identity: Parent v3 author broad T/B, native QC and family-marker background definition; exact original author identity labels enter nuisance covariates. No formal state assignments. GSE287472 author unavailable; ICON B category unavailable.
programme: Exact fixed336 programme genes per model_key, LR and receiver-name excluded by parent contract; mean log1p(native count/full-native-target-total*10000) over uniquely measurable genes, at least4genes and60%remaining-set coverage. Missing gene not zero. Preserve zeros of measurable genes. Use selected native caches when complete; read full-source gene aliases for additional exhaustion genes. Full target total unchanged.

geometry.native_coordinates: cached coords/.12028 and original Area pixels; independent micron calibration unverified
geometry.rationale: New programme/niche question covers several cell diameters; parent2radius was a contact-scale diagnostic, not proof of absence across larger niches. Finite6 declared before any new programme/exposure coefficients. No radius selected by p value.
geometry.density: All-QC neighbour count within the same radius used in a model

exposure: Number of ligand-positive sender-family neighbours / number of ALL sender-family neighbours. R-positive receiver with no sender-family neighbour is exposure-missing, not zero. With sender-family neighbours but no L-positive neighbours, exposure=0. Same-cell neighbour forbidden; CCL5/IL7R overlap remains explicit.
primary_model: R-positive receivers only, >=40eligiblecells and at least20 residual degrees of freedom; programme and exposure variance required. OLS programme~fraction_L_positive_neighbours + standardized log1p(nativeRNA),log1p(nativeDetectedGenes),log(Area),log1p(allQCdegree),log1p(senderFamilyDegree) + all present FOV/author-label/receiver sender-family-membership categorical levels minus fixed last-level anchors. Rank or condition>1e8 => unestimable; no mandatory continuous covariate auto-drop. Counts of exposed/unexposed reported, not selected using >=20pergroup gate.

null.shuffle: Only ligand-positive sender label shuffled; recipient cells, R-positive status, programme, family positions, geometry and nuisance covariates fixed. Strata = FOV x receiver-family-membership x fixed receptor-positive flag x exact original sender-author label x above/below allQC-FOV RNA median x above/below allQC-FOV local density median. Strata constant/size1 preserved, no automatic merging.
null.sampling: Within each canonical sorted stratum, independent continuous Uniform random keys sorted to generate uniform permutations. This vectorization and seed sequence are frozen; all stratum L counts conserved.
null.statistic: Adjusted programme coefficient per unit local ligand-positive fraction. Exposure rederived for every permutation; nuisance matrix fixed. Null exposure residual variance<=1e-12 gives statistic0 and is counted explicitly, not omitted.
null.pvalue: Two-sided conditional permutation2min[(1+null>=observed)/(10001),(1+null<=observed)/(10001)], clipped1; null variance zero =>NA. Not cell iid p, not patient population inference.
null.BH: Full70unique programme-interface/file tests, unavailable/unestimable p=1 only internally; output p/q remainNA; mapped duplicate contexts not independent evidence.

sensitivities: Same main-model covariates/rank rules at radii2and12, observed beta only/no new significance family
Remove BOTH sender and receiver family-name genes from programme for a diagnostic score with same4/60%coverage rules; fixed main score preserved
Receptor-positive versus negative receiver programme association with QC/author/FOV/member nuisance matrix, observed beta only; this is phenotype not neighbour response
Report counts, mixed/overlapping endpoint behaviour, FOV concentration, leave-one-FOV adjusted effect and no-patient-map limits
acceptance: Exactly14 unique model definitions x5=70 primary and15x5=75mapped, all missing explicit
Verify parent/candidate/nativecache/source hashes and all additional genes from native-source aliases
Independent source-value fixtures, programmes/normalization/endpoints/exposure/rank and QR vs SVD coefficient checks
Independent random-key/stratum conservation and every10000conditional draw for all estimable primary models
Review full70 BH and all140radius/70name/70receptor phenotype diagnostics, no duplicated evidence
Production terminal manifests and exact process disappearance plus independent audit before version update

literature.use: Conceptual support for modelling receiver expression as a function of identity and niche; this task is a fixed programme diagnostic, not an NCEM package reproduction
Ligand-to-target concept; no claim that generic programme is proven ligand target

limits: All5 assays retained but author/panel limitations remain; HBEGF is not in current1000gene panel, so missing is not negative
FOV/TMA are not independent patients; tests conditional on observed tissues only
Programme and receptor positivity may reflect subtypes or technical/segmentation effects; no formal state or causal mechanism assignment
Different cancers can share directional cell-pair ecology without universal effects; current spatial source is one GSE
